queries.name: dashboard-ingestion-health
queries.subject: Expose the current collection state for the global ingestion indicator.
queries.objective: Distinguish reported ingestion failure or recovery from the age of retained workflow evidence.
queries.acceptance: Use the authorized server collection-health classification, not cumulative failures or browser refresh time. Missing or unauthorized health remains unknown and static dashboards do not request this source.

queries.name: dashboard-data-freshness
queries.subject: Find the newest workflow activity timestamp in retained canonical data.
queries.objective: Warn globally when the ingested workflow evidence has not advanced for 24 hours.
queries.acceptance: Use upstream updated-at, falling back to created-at, never browser import or refresh time. Missing or invalid timestamps remain unknown; inactivity alone does not prove an ingestion failure.

queries.name: indexing-shards
queries.subject: List retained Activity shard import receipts.
queries.objective: Inspect which shards were ingested, when, and how many records they committed.
queries.acceptance: Show shard scope, phase, import status, import timestamp, counts and payload identity from retained receipts. Import time is not upstream freshness and missing receipts do not prove complete coverage.

queries.name: ingestion-queued
queries.subject: Label the shared collection task queue depth for the administrator queue chart.
queries.objective: Identify total ready and scheduled collection work, including backfill tasks.
queries.acceptance: Show the observed shared queue depth only when collection is configured; missing or unauthorized health data is not zero pending work.

queries.name: ingestion-inflight
queries.subject: Label current in-flight collection tasks for the administrator queue chart.
queries.objective: Distinguish leased collection tasks from work awaiting collection.
queries.acceptance: Show the observed pending task count only when collection is configured; do not infer a count from an unavailable source.

queries.name: ingestion-backfill
queries.subject: Label cumulative backfill run admissions for the administrator ingestion chart.
queries.objective: Compare historically admitted run tasks with current outstanding work without treating admissions as a live backlog.
queries.acceptance: Show the cumulative run task admissions only when collection is configured; this value does not decrease as tasks complete and missing health data does not imply completed backfill.

queries.name: ingestion-queue-sizes
queries.subject: Compare current shared queue pressure, in-flight tasks, and cumulative historical backfill admissions from the administrator-only server snapshot.
queries.objective: Spot a growing backlog without treating past backfill admissions as outstanding work.
queries.acceptance: Current queue sizes and cumulative admissions come only from an authorized collection-health snapshot; unavailable state is not zero.

queries.name: ingestion-webhook-status
queries.subject: Inspect live webhook delivery counters for the current server process.
queries.objective: Distinguish signature validation, acknowledgements, rejections and failures without polling GitHub.
queries.acceptance: Show only authorized process-local counters, including in-flight requests, duplicate acknowledgements and signed pings. Counters reset on restart, are not replica totals, and do not establish GitHub-side webhook registration or completed collection. Refresh the active subscription even without canonical data changes.

queries.name: ingestion-health
queries.subject: Show the current Redis-backed webhook and collection health snapshot.
queries.objective: Determine whether the reported collection, webhook, queue, and backfill state warrants inspecting ingestion diagnostics.
queries.acceptance: Report the observed health, queue, failure, success, and projection timestamps together; verify freshness and configuration before calling collection healthy, and treat missing state as unknown rather than zero.

queries.name: github-api-usage
queries.subject: Show retained GitHub API quota usage per bucket and in aggregate over the last 24 hours.
queries.objective: Determine whether any GitHub App installation or the CAO fleet as a whole is approaching its GitHub API rate limit.
queries.acceptance: Report peak usage percentages with their limits, used, and reserved counts; treat a slot without observations as unknown rather than idle, and never infer credentials from bucket identity.

queries.name: marketplace-directory
queries.subject: Browse packages from configured marketplace registries.
queries.objective: Present a stable alphabetical directory that can be loaded in bounded pages.
queries.acceptance: Preserve resolver-produced provenance and package metadata. Order by package name and immutable source so continuation pages neither skip nor duplicate entries; discovery grants no installation authority.

queries.name: marketplace-package-detail
queries.subject: Expose normalized marketplace package records for source-coordinate lookup by the detail view.
queries.objective: Locate the resolver-produced package record for a source coordinate supplied by the consuming view.
queries.acceptance: Use the returned package-source, registry, ref, and resolved-commit fields when inspecting a matching record; the query itself does not filter by coordinate, and an absent match is not proof of package nonexistence or approval.

queries.name: friction-by-workflow
queries.subject: Rank workflows by observed gh-aw audit friction AI Credit totals for investigation.
queries.objective: Identify which repository and workflow combinations have the largest measured friction totals in retained observations.
queries.acceptance: Compare friction-aic and distinct runs with the underlying measurement states and attribution evidence; do not equate a ranking with avoidable cost or a validated saving.
queries.description: Total gh-aw audit friction cost grouped by repository and workflow.

queries.name: friction-observations
queries.subject: List retained gh-aw audit friction measurements with their run context and attribution totals.
queries.objective: Trace each reported friction measurement to a run and distinguish counted, suppressed, and unattributed occurrences.
queries.acceptance: Preserve native AIC, total-run AIC, measurement state, timestamps, links, and occurrence counts; missing or unattributed evidence remains uncertain, not a verified opportunity for savings.
queries.description: Newest friction measurements first, preserving the native audit values and uncertainty state.

queries.name: indexing-shard-dates
queries.subject: Read the activity date encoded in each retained transaction's shard filename.
queries.objective: Separate source shard dates from ingestion timestamps.
queries.acceptance: Keep every transaction and leave absent, invalid, or structural shard dates unknown; never substitute import time.

queries.name: indexing-ingestion-runs
queries.subject: Show retained ingestion transactions at the activity date encoded in their shard filename.
queries.objective: Compare reported run counts by source shard activity date, independently of import time.
queries.acceptance: Preserve every dated transaction, including coincident dates, all kinds, and zero counts, without grouping, limits, or page filters. Omit missing or invalid shard dates; never substitute import time. Missing counts use labeled zero-position placeholders, not measured zeroes.

queries.name: indexing-daily-run-counts
queries.subject: Inspect admitted daily logical Run counts independently of retained detail and shard receipts.
queries.objective: Make the daily run-count projection visible as an ingestion diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Sum daily buckets by observed UTC execution-start day across repositories and workflows, without page filters, detail fallback, fabricated days or zero populations. Preserve aggregate coverage and partial or unavailable evidence; counts do not prove upstream completeness.

queries.name: indexing-campaigns-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained campaigns rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained campaigns row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result campaigns and count campaign rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected campaign coverage.

queries.name: indexing-repositories-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained repositories rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained repositories row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result repositories and count repository rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected repository coverage.

queries.name: indexing-workflows-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained workflows rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained workflows row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result workflows and count workflow rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected workflow coverage.

queries.name: indexing-runs-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained workflow runs rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained workflow runs row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result workflow runs and count run rows in the current database; absence or zero does not establish completeness or expected execution volume.

queries.name: indexing-domains-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained network domains rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained network domains row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result network domains and count domain event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no network activity.

queries.name: indexing-tools-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained tool events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained tool events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result tool events and count tool event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no tool use.

queries.name: indexing-audits-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained audit events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained audit events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result audit events and count audit event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no audit findings.

queries.name: indexing-issues-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained issue events rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained issue events row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result issue events and count issue event rows in the current database; absence or zero does not prove no issues exist.

queries.name: indexing-operational-values-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained operational values rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained operational values row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result operational values and count operational-value rows in the current database; absence or zero does not imply zero value or an evaluated outcome.

queries.name: indexing-transactions-table-count
queries.subject: Count retained ingestion transactions rows in the dashboard database.
queries.objective: Provide the retained ingestion transactions row count for the table-count diagnostic.
queries.acceptance: Label the result ingestion transactions and count transaction IDs in the current database; absence or zero does not establish whether upstream ingestion ran.

queries.name: indexing-database-table-counts
queries.subject: Count retained canonical dashboard database rows by table.
queries.objective: Compare the retained table row counts to identify tables needing further ingestion or coverage investigation.
queries.acceptance: Union the named table-count projections and report their table labels and counts; check source availability, retention, and separate transaction evidence before interpreting an empty or small table as an ingestion defect.

queries.name: indexing-transactions
queries.subject: Prepare retained ingestion transactions for card presentation.
queries.objective: Expose transaction identity, kind, timestamp, committed-record count, and payload hash for ingestion traceability.
queries.acceptance: Projected fields match retained transactions without implying successful upstream coverage from a committed count or hash alone; missing transactions require a freshness and availability check.

queries.name: engines-models-sample-distribution
queries.subject: Describe agent and model combinations in the seven-day statistical run sample.
queries.objective: Find sampled combinations to investigate without scanning the full retained run history.
queries.acceptance: Count unweighted selected Runs after frame selection. Keep statistical-frame-id in grouped rows and frame metadata on empty results. Zero-allocation strata are not population zeros. Preserve unknown identifiers; failure reserves can alter composition. Never mix sample counts with exact usage or infer population shares.
queries.description: Unweighted composition of the seven-day statistical sample; not a population estimate. Failure outcomes may be oversampled.

queries.name: engines-models-usage
queries.subject: Summarize run-level AIC and token usage by agent and model identifiers without treating unavailable telemetry as zero.
queries.objective: Locate agent and model combinations whose observed per-run AIC or token usage merits checking against individual runs.
queries.acceptance: Report run counts and native minimum, mean, and maximum values only for reported metrics; inspect underlying runs for per-metric telemetry coverage and context before comparing combinations, and infer neither efficiency nor outcome value from usage alone.
queries.description: Observed workflow runs grouped by agent ID and model ID. AIC statistics use only positive-AIC runs; token statistics use runs that reported each token metric.

queries.name: skill-invocations
queries.subject: Select observed skill invocations for skill usage analytics.
queries.objective: Expose skill event identity, scope, invocation counts, and failed counts for downstream usage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Keep each observed event and its repository/workflow attribution with native counts; missing records or failed counts alone do not establish whether a skill was useful or available.

queries.name: skill-invocations-by-skill
queries.subject: Rank skills by their observed invocation count.
queries.objective: Identify skills with the highest observed invocation totals for follow-up inspection.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill and retain the rank as a usage description; do not equate popularity with effectiveness or infer unobserved invocations.

queries.name: skill-invocations-by-workflow-totals
queries.subject: Rank workflows by their observed skill invocation count.
queries.objective: Produce repository-scoped workflow invocation totals for downstream skill-usage comparison.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by organization, repository, and workflow; totals describe recorded usage only, not success or expected adoption.

queries.name: skill-invocations-by-workflow
queries.subject: Present workflow skill invocation totals with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Expose observed workflow skill invocation totals with a link to inspect each workflow.
queries.acceptance: Each projected workflow coordinate, link, and invocation total traces to the grouped source; using a link to investigate does not establish that usage caused an outcome.

queries.name: skill-workflow-totals
queries.subject: Count observed invocations for each skill and workflow.
queries.objective: Produce skill-by-workflow invocation totals for the downstream inventory.
queries.acceptance: Sum observed invocation counts by skill, organization, repository, and workflow; missing combinations are not evidence that a skill could not run.

queries.name: skill-workflow-inventory
queries.subject: List observed skills by workflow with drill-through navigation to the workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Identify observed skill/workflow combinations and provide a workflow link for inspecting their runs.
queries.acceptance: Show the repository, workflow, skill, link, and observed invocation total from the grouped evidence; an absent row does not prove non-use, and a high count does not prove effectiveness.

queries.name: experiment-assignment-coverage
queries.subject: Count observed run assignments for each experiment and workflow without inferring a completion target.
queries.objective: Expose assignment counts by experiment and workflow for investigating observed experiment coverage.
queries.acceptance: Count retained assignment rows in each experiment/workflow group, not distinct runs; do not invent a target, infer missing assignments from absent groups, or treat assignments as eval or grader outcomes.

queries.name: eval-status-ledger
queries.subject: Inspect every explicitly classified eval answer, including UNKNOWN.
queries.objective: Expose retained eval observations with their workflow, run evidence and observation time.
queries.acceptance: Keep recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answers distinct; unknown or absent evidence must not imply success or failure, and historical answers are not current verdicts or validated operational outcomes.

queries.name: eval-answer-counts
queries.subject: Count recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answers for each workflow-scoped eval.
queries.objective: Provide complete answer denominators before expanding each eval into three bars.
queries.acceptance: Keep canonical eval identities separate and count only explicitly classified observations. Select at most 33 complete eval groups, never truncate an answer group.

queries.name: eval-yes-shares
queries.subject: Compute the YES share of each eval's recorded answers.
queries.objective: Expose recorded YES proportions for comparing answer categories without inferring verified operational outcomes.
queries.acceptance: Emit one YES row per retained canonical eval group, including zero YES counts; answer-share is yes / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Do not count absent observations.

queries.name: eval-no-shares
queries.subject: Compute the NO share of each eval's recorded answers.
queries.objective: Expose recorded NO proportions for comparing answer categories without treating historical answers as current verdicts.
queries.acceptance: Emit one NO row per retained canonical eval group, including zero NO counts; answer-share is no / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Do not count absent observations.

queries.name: eval-unknown-shares
queries.subject: Compute the explicit UNKNOWN share of each eval's recorded answers.
queries.objective: Expose explicitly recorded UNKNOWN proportions without conflating absent observations with classified uncertainty.
queries.acceptance: Emit one UNKNOWN row per retained canonical eval group, including zero UNKNOWN counts; answer-share is unknown / answers across recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN observations. Missing observations are not UNKNOWN answers.

queries.name: eval-answer-distribution
queries.subject: Compare YES, NO and UNKNOWN percentages within each eval.
queries.objective: Show three horizontal bars per eval that together account for all recorded answers.
queries.acceptance: Emit all three answer categories, including zero shares; percentages sum to 100 per canonical eval. Missing observations are not UNKNOWN answers. Preserve workflow and repository attribution.

queries.name: grader-observed-maxima
queries.subject: Find each workflow-scoped grader's maximum retained value in the selected data.
queries.objective: Provide an observed normalization denominator without mixing grader identities or claiming a theoretical maximum.
queries.acceptance: Group by canonical grader identity, not display name; ignore missing values and preserve zero or negative maxima without substituting a denominator.

queries.name: grader-normalized-observations
queries.subject: Normalize each grader observation by that grader's observed maximum.
queries.objective: Compare relative grader values over time while preserving native measurements and run provenance.
queries.acceptance: Compute value / max-grader-value without clamping or inverting lower-is-better measures; zero or missing denominators produce null, never a fabricated zero or infinity.

queries.name: grader-value-scatter
queries.subject: Plot timed grader observations with a defined value-to-observed-maximum ratio.
queries.objective: Show relative grader measurements at their recorded observation times.
queries.acceptance: Keep each eligible observation and its run link; omit missing ratios or observation times from the plot while retaining those records in the native-value ledger. Ratios are not eval answers or evidence of improvement.

queries.name: grader-status-ledger
queries.subject: Report grader measurements, units and explicit statuses without confusing them with binary eval answers.
queries.objective: Preserve numeric grader evidence and distinguish explicit per-observation pass and fail verdicts from unknown statuses.
queries.acceptance: Retain native grader values, units and statuses. Map only pass/passed to YES and fail/failed to NO in the auxiliary verdict field, leaving all other statuses unknown; never infer an eval answer, current success, causation or policy authority from a grader score.

pages.intent: Find campaign packages whose documented purpose fits an operational need.
pages.subject: Normalized packages from the configured campaign registries.
pages.objective: Select a package for review before considering installation.
pages.acceptance: Preserve package source, identity and metadata provenance; distinguish unavailable registry data from no matches. Add commands are copy-only and use no AI; discovery grants no installation or target authority.

pages.description: Find a campaign package that addresses a specific CAO operational need.

views.title: Campaign packages for agentic operations

pages.subject: The package selected by the route and its normalized registry metadata.
pages.objective: Make an informed package-selection decision without executing installation.
pages.acceptance: Show exact package source, README and metadata; keep add commands copy-only and report unavailable content. Add commands use no AI; package text is untrusted and grants no rollout authority.
pages.title: Package
pages.description: Verify the selected package's provenance before considering installation.

pages.intent: Determine whether collection, ingestion and retained data are healthy enough for analysis.
pages.subject: Server collection health, API usage, ingestion queues, daily run counts, shards and retained transactions.
pages.objective: Locate evidence gaps and bottlenecks before trusting dashboard conclusions.
pages.acceptance: Show native states, timestamps, counts, sizes and units with backend limitations; preserve failures and partial/unavailable evidence. Empty queues or tables alone do not establish successful collection.
pages.title: Ingestion
pages.description: Determine whether the evidence pipeline supports reliable CAO analysis.

views.title: Data storage
views.objective: Identify the configured storage engine and location. This source-free element reads deployment configuration, not activity evidence; a database query cannot identify the browser's storage configuration.

views.title: Database table counts
views.subject: Compare retained row counts across dashboard database tables.
views.objective: Identify missing or unexpectedly sized data tables for ingestion review.
views.acceptance: Counts are used as ingestion diagnostics, not as proof of source completeness.
views.description: Rows retained by canonical database table or object-store name, including transactions.
views.empty-message: No canonical dashboard rows have been retained.

views.title: Observed daily runs
views.subject: Inspect the daily run-count projection by UTC execution-start day.
views.objective: Compare admitted daily logical Run volume independently of retained detail and per-shard input counts.
views.acceptance: Show observed day totals only, preserving partial coverage and unavailable projection state. Counts do not establish complete upstream collection or verified outcomes.
views.description: Daily logical Run counts across all repositories and workflows, by observed UTC execution-start day, not import or shard date. Counts survive detail eviction and do not count attempts separately. Undated runs are excluded; missing days are not measured zeroes. Partial coverage does not reconstruct evicted history, and admitted counts do not prove complete upstream collection.
views.empty-message: No dated daily Run observations are available. Collection coverage remains unknown.

views.title: Ingested shards
views.subject: Inspect retained Activity shard import receipts.
views.objective: Trace imported shards and investigate stale dashboard evidence.
views.acceptance: Display retained shard paths, kind, status, import times, record counts and hashes. Unknown fields remain unknown and successful imports do not establish upstream freshness.
views.description: Retained shard receipts show the source path, import time, committed records and payload hash. Importing an old shard does not make its workflow evidence current.
views.empty-message: No shard import receipts are available. Shard coverage and freshness are unknown.

views.title: Webhook counters (process-local, since restart)
views.subject: Inspect webhook validation and HTTP outcomes observed by this server process.
views.objective: Spot invalid signatures, failed admission and active webhook traffic without querying GitHub.
views.acceptance: Display process-local counts and last-observed timestamps; missing or unauthorized evidence is unavailable, not zero. Acknowledged pings do not prove current GitHub registration and acknowledgements do not mean collection has completed.
views.description: Live counters for this server process, refreshed every 30 seconds while this view is open. Reset on restart; not aggregated across replicas. Verified means valid HMAC, acknowledged means HTTP acceptance, and duplicate and ping counts overlap acknowledgements. A ping does not prove current GitHub-side registration.
views.empty-message: Live webhook counters are unavailable. No traffic or registration state can be inferred.

views.title: Server collection workload (administrators)
views.subject: Compare the current shared collection queue and in-flight work with cumulative historical backfill admissions.
views.objective: Detect a collection backlog while distinguishing the historical volume of backfill work.
views.acceptance: Display only authorized server observations; backfill admissions are cumulative, not an outstanding queue, and unavailable or unconfigured state is not zero.
views.description: Ready and scheduled work includes webhook and backfill tasks; in-flight tasks are leased. Backfill admitted is a cumulative total, not a current backlog. Available only to server administrators.
views.empty-message: Collection queue sizes are available only to server administrators when collection is configured.

views.title: Collection health
views.description: Live webhook admission, queue, retry, and collection health from the server-side collection profile.
views.empty-message: Live collection health is available when connected to a server-side collection profile.

views.title: GitHub API usage
views.subject: Track the share of GitHub API quota consumed by each CAO bucket over the last 24 hours.
views.objective: Spot GitHub App installations approaching their rate limit before collection or other GitHub-backed work is throttled.
views.acceptance: Each point is the peak observed usage in the hour; usage is read against the bucket's reset window and parking state, and a missing point means no observation rather than zero usage.
views.description: Peak hourly percentage of GitHub API quota used per App installation and resource, with the limit-weighted total across all buckets.
views.empty-message: GitHub API usage is available to administrators when connected to a server that records GitHub quota observations.

views.title: Runs per ingestion
views.subject: Track the reported run count of every retained ingestion entry.
views.objective: Identify changes in run volume by the activity date encoded in each source shard filename, not its import time.
views.acceptance: Every transaction with a valid shard activity date is represented without date bucketing or aggregation; unavailable dates are not replaced by import time and unavailable counts are labeled, not inferred as measured zeroes.
views.description: Entries are positioned by the UTC activity date in the source shard filename, not when imported. Entries without a valid shard date are not plotted. Missing run counts are labeled and shown at 0 as placeholders, not measured zeroes. Reported counts are input runs, not distinct retained runs.
views.empty-message: No ingestion entries with a valid shard activity date have been retained.

views.title: Ingestion transactions
views.description: Retained transactions show the time, committed record volume, and payload hash for each ingestion operation.
views.empty-message: No ingestion transactions have been retained.

pages.intent: Determine which skill-usage pattern needs workflow-level investigation.
pages.subject: Retained skill invocation observations in the selected scope and horizon.
pages.objective: Locate skill-usage evidence for workflow-level investigation.
pages.acceptance: Count observed invocations by skill and workflow, retain drill-down identity and disclose coverage. Invocation volume is not proof of skill quality, success or operational value.

pages.acceptance: Keep engine/model identity and unknown values explicit; distinguish AIC from raw tokens and preserve token classes, units and time bounds. Do not infer model quality or missing cost from usage volume.

pages.title: Updates

views.title: CAO packages
views.description: Installed campaign revisions and the latest catalog revisions observed for this control repository. Unknown update confidence does not mean the package is current.
views.empty-message: No CAO campaign packages were observed.

pages.intent: Inspect which workflow runs have recorded experiment assignments.
pages.subject: Retained run-linked assignments grouped by workflow and experiment.
pages.objective: Assess assignment evidence before designing an experiment comparison.
pages.acceptance: Show assignment counts and identities with coverage limits. Audit evidence does not establish campaign milestones or target assignments; counts are not completion percentages or proof of treatment effects.
pages.title: Experiments
pages.description: Assess whether retained experiment assignments are sufficient for a bounded comparison.

views.title: Observed assignments by workflow and experiment
views.subject: Compare retained experiment assignments across workflows and experiments.
views.objective: Identify assignment coverage that needs inspection before interpreting experimental evidence.
views.acceptance: An assignment count is treated as observation coverage, not as an experiment result or effect.
views.empty-message: No experiment assignments were observed.

views.title: Run assignments
views.description: Explicit observed variants for retained runs. Assignments are not experiment outcomes or treatment effects.
views.empty-message: No experiment assignments were observed.

views.description: Experiment definitions discovered in run-level audit evidence. Missing campaign progress targets are not inferred.
views.empty-message: No experiment definitions were observed.

pages.intent: Inspect retained eval answers by workflow without mistaking history for current verdicts.
pages.subject: Timestamped native YES, NO and UNKNOWN eval observations.
pages.objective: Locate evaluation evidence and gaps for further investigation.
pages.acceptance: Keep eval identity, workflow, observation time and provenance; label only explicit YES/NO answers as such. UNKNOWN remains distinct; absent authoritative current-result pointers, older observations are not current verdicts.
pages.title: Evals
pages.description: Compare recorded YES, NO and UNKNOWN answer percentages for each eval, then inspect the retained evidence.

views.title: Eval answer distribution
views.subject: Recorded answer percentages for each workflow-scoped eval.
views.objective: Compare the YES, NO and UNKNOWN shares without conflating missing evidence with an unknown answer.
views.acceptance: Show three bars per eval, including zero shares, whose values sum to 100%. Keep workflow identities separate and preserve the evidence ledger.
views.description: Each eval has YES, NO and UNKNOWN bars totaling 100% of its recorded answers. Up to 33 evals are shown, ordered by name; Table view retains all observations. Missing observations are not counted as UNKNOWN.
views.empty-message: No eval observations were retained.

views.title: Observed eval answers by workflow
views.empty-message: No eval observations were retained.

pages.intent: Compare normalized grader values over time and inspect their native evidence.
pages.subject: Run-linked grader results and native metric evidence grouped by workflow.
pages.objective: Show each grader value relative to its observed maximum while keeping the native-value ledger available for evidence review.
pages.acceptance: Plot time against value divided by the maximum for that grader in the selected data; missing values and zero maxima do not produce points. Preserve grader identity, native values/status, units and times; unknown is not pass/fail. Historical observations are not current verdicts or verified gains.
pages.title: Graders
pages.description: Compare grader values over time relative to each grader's observed maximum, then inspect native measurements in the ledger.

views.title: Grader values relative to observed maximum
views.subject: Timed grader observations normalized by each grader's maximum in the selected data.
views.objective: Compare relative measurements and follow a point to its producing run.
views.acceptance: Preserve each point's timestamp and value/max ratio without connecting or clamping values; omit missing ratios and zero maxima. Normalization is not an eval answer or proof of improvement.
views.description: Each point is value / maximum observed value for the same grader and workflow. Zero or missing maxima are not plotted. Ratios are not eval answers or proof of improvement.
views.empty-message: No timed grader values have a nonzero observed maximum. Native observations remain in the ledger below.

views.title: Observed grader results by workflow
views.empty-message: No grader observations were retained.

pages.intent: Review checked-in control-repository policy before proposing a configuration change.
pages.subject: Entries in the control repository's .github/workflows/cao.json.
pages.objective: Understand explicit scope, modes and enablement without inferring broader authority.
pages.acceptance: Preserve policy identity and provenance, distinguish missing settings from permission, and fail closed on unavailable policy. Policy edits require explicit reviewed authorization; never expose credentials or silently promote live mode.
pages.title: Settings
pages.description: Review checked-in CAO policy before proposing an authorized configuration change.

views.title: Policy
views.description: Change policy values, then copy the updated JSON for review and commit.
